name: compaction-harness
title: Compaction Harness redesign
description: Audit and redesign TakiAgent's Compaction Harness around token-first Replay View boundaries, independent of Memory Provider lifecycle, using the verified DSH compaction/token-meter patterns while preserving Character-scoped companion continuity and one common Run/Turn runtime.
scope: packages/core replay/compaction/context management, Memory composition boundary, DSH comparison research, planning artifacts and regression design; no D68-B UI implementation
creator: pleia
notes: Research is complete in research/current-compaction-design.md and research/dsh-compaction-design.md. Slice 1 is implemented and formally checked: measured Replay View source loading is token-first, compaction retirement uses a DSH-grounded 0.16 priced tail with balanced tool units, and keepMessages remains only a minimum-tail guard. Planning still records the provider-independent target, preserves T5 R2 as the current overflow baseline, and splits remaining work into four bounded slices; Slice 2 remains pending and no task-level owner acceptance is implied.
